title: Canton Network validator operator inventory
description: Non-secret inventory an agent needs to operate a Canton Network validator. Never place onboarding secrets, identities dumps, database passwords, wallet passwords or alert tokens in this file.

operator_label.description: Human-readable operator label. Do not include secrets.

network.description: Selects the /info endpoint and the scan access expectation. MainNet and TestNet scan are reachable only from onboarded validator IPs.

host.description: SSH target, or 'local' when the agent runs on the validator host.

compose_project.description: Docker Compose project name prefix. Container names derive from it, and the monitoring stack joins <project>_splice_validator.

compose_working_dir.description: Absolute path of the running Compose project, e.g. ~/.canton/0.8.0/splice-node/docker-compose/validator. Read it from the container label rather than trusting a 'current' symlink.

party_hint.description: Validator party hint passed to start.sh -p. Must stay identical across a re-onboarding or the recovered party is a different party.

party_id.description: Full party ID including the namespace fingerprint. Public.

participant_id.description: Participant identifier passed to start.sh -P after a re-onboarding. Must be reused on every later restart.

migration_id.description: Network migration ID. Also the suffix of the participant database name (participant-<migration_id>). Verify against /info before relying on it.

sponsor_sv_url.description: Sponsoring Super Validator URL passed to start.sh -s.

scan_url.description: Scan base URL passed to start.sh -c.

auth_disabled.description: True when the deployment runs compose-disable-auth.yaml. Safe only while nginx stays bound to 127.0.0.1.

wallet_bind.description: Bind address of the nginx fronting the wallet and ANS UIs. Anything other than a loopback address is a finding.

backup.description: Backup destinations. Credentials never belong here.

database_target.description: Where the Postgres dumps are shipped, e.g. an rsync path or an object-store bucket name.

identities_target.description: Which secret manager holds the identities dump. The dump itself must never be stored in this inventory or beside the database dumps.

retention_days.description: Database dumps older than 30 days cannot restore a participant, so retention below 30 days is only safe with a current identities backup.
